description: HomeMaster's catalogue: every service it takes today. Call it first, with no arguments, whenever the person names a job, before you say HomeMaster does or does not do it. Home cleaning and aircon servicing are booked online: you get the options for each (cleaning visit lengths and how often; aircon jobs and unit counts) and their list prices in SGD, GST included. Call this first when you need the options. For an exact price with offers, use get_quote. Other home services, when any are listed under more_services, are arranged by our team: call this tool again with `service` set to one of their codes for what is included, the price list or a price guide, and how the customer requests it.

service.description: Optional: one service code from this tool's own list (for example a code under more_services), to get that service in full.

name: find_services
title: Find HomeMaster services and prices
